title: "sampling"
format: html

```{r}
library(dplyr)

jose <- read_csv("starRiders.csv") |> filter(rider == "Jose")

josePoints <- jose |> filter(score != 0)

josePoints <- josePoints |> select(!rider)

write_csv(josePoints, "joseCareerScores.csv")

josePoints <- josePoints |> filter(season == 2025) |> summarise(mean(score))
```
